name: Landmine Rotation
steps: Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine or corner.
Stand wide and hold the free end at chest height with arms straight.
Turn your hips and shoulders to bring the bar down to one hip.
Breathe out and rotate back up through the middle to the other hip.
cues: Pivot the feet with the turn

common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter load and slow the arc
Keep arms long; let the trunk move the bar

common_mistakes.mistake: Feet stuck flat, twisting the knees
common_mistakes.fix: Let the back foot pivot as you turn
